description: Signs the signed-in person up to a Gymmy gym's membership or class pack (from get_prices), paid on the gym's own Stripe Checkout page. First call without confirm returns the summary to confirm; then confirm: true with first_name and last_name returns the payment link. Follow up with checkout_status. For a single class or a trial with a class, use book_dropin.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes to the summary returned by the first call.

first_name.description: The person's first name (asked once, needed with confirm).

gym.description: Gym identifier: the `gym` value from search_gyms (page slug or Gymmy id).

last_name.description: The person's last name (needed with confirm).

site_id.description: Site id when the gym has several.

name: join_gym
title: Join a gym
